summary: Verification passed for the LLM bridge feature after fixing the root no-isolation Python build environment by adding setuptools and wheel to the dev extra and resyncing uv.

env PATH=.venv/bin:... .venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run run_build --project . --input '{}'

results.evidence: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q returned 0: 23 passed with one StarletteDeprecationWarning from FastAPI/TestClient.
bun test in llm_bridge/ returned 0: 1 test passed, 0 failed, including provider upsert response does not echo stored api key.
bun run typecheck in llm_bridge/ returned 0 and ran tsc --noEmit.
npm run typecheck in frontend/ returned 0 and ran vue-tsc --noEmit.
npm run build in frontend/ returned 0; Vite transformed 32 modules and wrote index-Bto0ykgx.js plus index-C_67LZJ9.css under appforge/resources/web/assets.
run_tests tool returned success with command python -m pytest -q, skipped=false, 23 passed.

Initial run_build failed because setuptools.build_meta was unavailable. After adding setuptools>=69 and wheel>=0.43 to the dev extra and running uv sync --extra dev, run_build returned success and built openappforge-0.4.0.tar.gz plus openappforge-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl. Setuptools license deprecation warnings remain non-blocking.
detect_quality_commands with .venv/bin on PATH detected tests [python -m pytest -q] and build [python -m build --no-isolation].

acceptance_results.evidence: TopBar emits open-settings, App.vue renders ProviderSettings, and npm run typecheck/build passed.
ProviderSettings uses typed API helpers for providers, models, save/delete, test, active selection, and health refresh; frontend typecheck/build passed.
tests/test_web.py test_llm_provider_api_proxies_to_bridge passed as part of the full 23-test suite.
tests/test_web.py test_llm_bridge_health_requires_configured_active_provider passed; create_driver and readiness paths are covered by full pytest and source inspection.
llm_bridge server/config/registry/type surfaces passed bun run typecheck.

bun test confirms provider upsert responses do not echo saved API keys; source inspection confirms provider status uses has_key/key_source metadata; full secret scan is handled by the dedicated security stage.
Full Python suite passed and AppForge run_tests gate passed; existing non-bridge driver branches remain present.
npm run typecheck, npm run build, and bun run typecheck all returned 0.
Frontend lockfile build path passed after package-lock registry normalization and .npmrc replace-registry-host=always.

coverage: Automated coverage includes full Python suite, targeted FastAPI readiness/proxy tests, bridge TypeScript type contracts, frontend Vue/TypeScript contracts, frontend production packaging, and root Python package build. Live provider calls are intentionally manual because they require user credentials and third-party availability.
manual_checks: Inspected appforge/llm_bridge.py, llm_bridge/src/config.ts, llm_bridge/src/server.ts, and llm_bridge/src/registry.ts to verify bridge config path, redacted provider status, no raw saved config echo, and local same-origin proxy boundary.
Verified appforge/tooling quality detection needs .venv/bin on PATH because this shell has no bare python executable.
Verified generated Python build artifacts live under ignored dist/ and are not source changes.
Live provider connectivity was not run because no user API key was supplied; ProviderSettings exposes manual test action for that path.
